description: This file defines the PersistableImage class, representing an image entity with properties such as byte array data, content type, and image name, along with their respective getters and setters.

classes.name: PersistableImage
classes.description: A POJO class for storing image data, content type, and image name used in the catalog product module.

methods.name: setBytes
methods.description: Sets the byte array data of the image.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.description: Returns the byte array data of the image.

methods.name: setContentType
methods.description: Sets the MIME content type of the image.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the MIME content type of the image.

methods.name: setImageName
methods.description: Sets the name of the image.

methods.name: getImageName
methods.description: Returns the name of the image.
